program: Research Tool External Gates and Staging Activation
blockers: The official postgres:17-alpine and postgres:17-bookworm images both retain one CRITICAL and multiple HIGH Trivy findings in the bundled gosu helper; an approved replacement digest or documented risk acceptance is required.
Docker Scout is installed but requires Docker ID authentication; no login was attempted.
No approved malware-scanner adapter or scanner service is present.
No live GROBID service or non-sensitive representative PDF fixture is present.
No live S3-compatible client implementation, disposable service, or authorized staging bucket is present.
No OIDC adapter, issuer, audience, JWKS policy, or authorized test identity configuration is present.
Rate limiting is process-local and no approved shared or edge limiter is configured.
No disposable TLS/reverse-proxy topology or staging certificate owner is present.
The repository-wide pytest run and broad frontend lint were bounded after Windows-environment stalls; focused checks passed but broad gates remain environment-blocked.
The document-bearing staging lifecycle cannot be called complete until malware, parser, storage, identity, and network-edge gates are supplied.
external_actions_required: Provide an approved PostgreSQL image digest with no unresolved exploitable HIGH/CRITICAL findings, or a security-owner exception for the exact gosu findings.
Provide an approved malware scanner and adapter contract, including health, clean-file, EICAR, unavailable, timeout, quarantine, and canonical-write ordering tests.
Provide a disposable GROBID endpoint/image and a non-sensitive representative PDF; supply GROBID_URL by secret-managed staging configuration only.
Provide a disposable S3-compatible service or approved staging bucket and owner; configure only the approved variable names and never paste secret values into the repository.
Provide an authorized OIDC test issuer, audience, JWKS/key-rotation policy, callback URLs, tenant memberships, role mappings, and test users.
Provide the approved shared or edge rate-limiter topology and failure policy for the intended replica count.
Provide a private staging reverse proxy, trusted-forwarded-header policy, HTTPS certificate, host/CORS values, and metrics restriction policy without public DNS changes.
next_action: Obtain the exact operator-controlled staging services and approved PostgreSQL image disposition listed in EXTERNAL_GATES.md, then rerun only the blocked validations.
